visualCharacteristics.structure: stack of full-width grey (#ebebeb) question bars with a blue circled plus/minus icon on the right; answer rich text below an open bar; all closed on load

contentPattern: N rows, 2 cells each: [question text] | [answer rich text (paragraphs, links, lists)]
reuseGuidance: Use for FAQ / question-answer lists that start collapsed (source c01-accordion with collapsed items). Not for legal disclaimers that start open (use accordion-legal).
